hyps.why: Replacing a parameter-free skip with a 3x3 conv gives a far larger gain (+43 on C10) than replacing other ops.
Upgrading a skip on the output edge to a conv gave +45 on C10/C100, versus about 0 to +3 on convs or none.
Replacing a pooling edge with a conv gives a large gain across datasets, unlike replacing a skip or conv in mixed parents.
Removing edge 4 when edge 3 is none can cut the input-to-output path, causing catastrophic accuracy drops.
Replacing a skip with a 3x3 conv on edge 4 gave +35 on C10, much more than other starting ops.
Replacing a pooling edge with a conv gives a large gain, much more than replacing none or skip in mixed parents.
Converting a skip edge to a 1x1 conv gave a big gain (+32 on C10) whereas edits from convs gave around 0.
Removing a skip on the output edge helped a lot (+42 on C10), while removing a conv hurt.
Removing a skip edge gave large gains on C10/C100 (+28), while removing a conv gave little or negative change.
Restoring a missing edge 3 with a skip connect adds a direct path and improved accuracy in the none-parent cases.
